## Summary of the Investigation

The root cause of the inconsistent outfit image format is in **`OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx`** at lines 55-58:

```typescript
const flatLayImage = outfit.flatLayImageUrl || outfit.flatLayImageBase64
const fallbackImage = outfit.imageUrl  // <-- This is mannequin-style!
const displayImage = flatLayImage || fallbackImage
```

When AI flat-lay generation fails or is unavailable, the component falls back to `outfit.imageUrl`, which is a mannequin-style product thumbnail from the catalog. This violates the specification in `looks.md` that requires all outfit recommendations to display as flat-lay compositions.

The fix involves:
1. Using `FlatLayComposite` as an intermediate fallback instead of raw product thumbnails
2. The fallback priority becomes: AI flat-lay → CSS FlatLayComposite → (never mannequin images)
